messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw a spike in provisional token credits for a small set of streaming sessions after we enabled ephemeral resume yesterday. Affected flows are: client reconnect -> resume -> fallback to ephemeral -> resume again.

devin: Can you paste the repro steps? I want to run against staging.

maria: repro (staging):
1) open stream with session_id=S123 and server-assigned tracelet=T-A
2) force short heartbeat gap to trigger fallback: send SIGPIPE or kill worker
3) client reconnects and resumes with same session_id but new resume_nonce
4) server routes to ephemeral capacity, then handoff back to primary; we see two provisional line items in the ledger for the same logical token window

ash: logs show resume handled by different router instances. Looks like tracelet id used for dedupe is only present on primary, ephemeral assigns a new tracelet so dedupe key differs.

neha: Is this causing actual double billing or just provisional duplicates? Product needs to know ASAP for console UX messaging.

maria: provisional duplicates. Billing reconciler collapses them later but customers see temporary overage alerts in console and Ops gets paged.

samir: probable root: dedupe key = tracelet || (session_id + toolcall_id). Since ephemeral drops tracelet, we fall back to session+toolcall which can be missing for streaming-only flows. Race: ephemeral assigns temporary toolcall id, then primary assigns final toolcall id -> two different keys.

devin: Suggestion: include resume_nonce in dedupe key if present, and mark provisional ledger entries with ephemeral_flag so reconciler merges. Quick patch in router: add resume_nonce when available.

ash: careful — resume_nonce can be attacker-controlled (client retries). We need server-assigned monotonic resume_ticket signed by KMS to be safe. We don't have that in ephemeral yet.

maria: minimal mitigation: when routing from ephemeral -> primary, if both ledger entries overlap token ranges and share session_id, mark newer entry as provisional-merged: true. That avoids visible double-charge until reconciler runs.

neha: console UX: can we suppress the overage alert for provisional-merged events and show a single combined entry? Ops wants an audit trail though. 

samir: from telemetry POV, add a tag 'resume_path=ephemeral' to these flows so we can query them. Also emit a metric counter resume_double_provisional_count{region, model, route}.

devin: I'll prototype change: in router on handoff, call ledger.MergeIfOverlap(session_id, resume_nonce, token_range). Pseudocode:

```
// in handoff handler
if (route == ephemeral && handoff.to_primary) {
  ledger.MergeIfOverlap(session_id, resume_nonce, start_token, end_token)
}
```

ash: OK but add defensiveness: MergeIfOverlap must check entry provenance and only merge provisional entries within a 60s window. Otherwise we risk collapsing legitimate distinct charges.

maria: also add a debug UI toggle in console to show merged provisional rows for a session_id so SRE can triage.

billing-bot: Billing alert: 14 provisional credits created in last 5m for session prefix S123. Investigate. :warning:

neha: thanks billing-bot. I'll add a console suppress rule for provisional-merged for the next deploy and we can remove after reconciler fix.

samir: will add telemetry dashboards: heatmap of provisional merges by model and route. Helps see if certain models cause more race conditions due to longer kv-eviction times.

devin: assigned -> I'll open a tiny PR to add resume_nonce to routing dedupe, plus ledger.MergeIfOverlap. Want to ship to staging today.

ash: +1 but add unit tests for edge cases: different clients using same session_id (unlikely but possible), and toolcall truncation where end_token is unknown.

maria: great. Action items:
- devin: PR for dedupe + MergeIfOverlap (staging)
- samir: telemetry + metric + dashboard (staging)
- neha: console suppress rule + debug toggle (staging)
- ash: add unit/integration tests for merge safety

maria: thanks everyone. I'll keep the thread updated with staging results.

devin: quick note — repro command for staging: `make e2e STREAM_SESSION=S123 HEARTBEAT_DELAY=12s ROUTE=ephemeral`

maria: ran that already, forwarded logs to #eng-logs. Logged sample: `resume_nonce=0x9f4, tracelet=null, provisional_id=p-8f7`

neha: ETA for console change? Can do a hotfix toggle within 2 hours.

ash: I'll start on tests now.

maria: OK closing for now, reopen if staging shows continued duplicates. :thumbsup:
